subject.title: Plugin context engines cannot increment /status compaction count

question: Which plugin-owned compaction reporting contract should OpenClaw make stable for updating session compaction counts?
rationale: The issue is valid from source inspection, but the fix changes the public context-engine/plugin lifecycle contract and must choose a stable reporting shape before implementation.

options.title: Add an afterTurn notification callback
options.body: Extend `afterTurn` params with an additive `notifyCompaction(count?: number)` callback and persist successful deltas through the existing session counter path.

options.title: Return compaction metadata from hooks
options.body: Change `afterTurn` or maintenance results to return optional compaction deltas, trading a broader result contract for less callback-style API surface.

options.title: Expose engine stats for status
options.body: Add a query-style stats contract and let status read engine metrics, trading lower write-path coupling for more runtime/plugin lookup and freshness complexity.

recommendation.title: Add an afterTurn notification callback
recommendation.body: Extend `afterTurn` params with an additive `notifyCompaction(count?: number)` callback and persist successful deltas through the existing session counter path.

likelyOwner.reason: The central decision is on the context-engine plugin lifecycle introduced and maintained by jalehman in the relevant feature history.
